recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-8018 unless the Pharmacy WG later changes the exemplar value set scope.
issue_request: FHIR-8018 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue requesting an example value set for DSTU1 MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction.asNeeded[x], with a voted resolution to add SCT 404684003 Clinical Finding (finding).
initial_application: No FHIR-8018-tagged git commit was found. The requested content appears to have been applied in commit 1d00edee44, which added the common dosage-instruction source, the MedicationAsNeededReason example binding, and source/datatypes/valueset-medication-as-needed-reason.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-8115 is explicitly related to FHIR-8018 and covers the same missing MedicationAsNeededReason reference/value set. Current fhir.ini lists Dosage and MedicationRequest as active build inputs, and later Dosage refactors preserved the binding while changing the old asNeeded[x] shape to asNeeded/asNeededFor.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/datatypes/dosage.xml binds Dosage.asNeededFor to MedicationAsNeededReason with example strength, and source/datatypes/valueset-medication-as-needed-reason.xml defines http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-as-needed-reason as SNOMED CT descendants of 404684003.
